rows.author: F006
rows.title_full: SYMPATHY AND SUPPORT FOR THE VICTIMS OF THE RECENT EARTHQUAKE IN CHINA
rows.abstract: SEEK THE APPROVAL OF THE MEMBERS ON A RESOLUTION URGING THE PHILIPPINE GOVERNMENT TO EXTEND HUMANITARIAN SUPPORT TO THE VICTIMS OF THE EARTHQUAKE IN CHINA. rows.abstract: TASKED THE DOH FOR ITS UNILATERAL ACTION TO IMPLEMENT A NEW SYSTEM RELATIVE TO THE INTEGRATED DRUG TEST OPERATION MANAGEMENT(IDTOM) WITHOUT CONSULTING THE ASSOCIATION OF MEDICAL CLINICS FOR OVERSEAS WORKERS (AMCO). rows.author: F051
rows.title_full: FAILURE OF THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE AND NEDA TO HANDLE THE CURRENT RICE CRISIS
rows.abstract: TASKED THE DA AND THE NEDA FOR THEIR FAILURE IN IMPLEMENTING THE APPROPRIATE AGRICULTURAL AND ECONOMIC POLICIES THAT SHOULD HAVE ADDRESSED THE CURRENT RICE CRISIS.  UNDERSCORED THAT THE GOVERNMENT'S RESPONSE TO ALLEVIATE THIS CRISIS HAD INSTEAD RESULTED TO A DISADVANTAGEOUS ECONOMIC POLICY.  ENUNCIATED THE NEED TO MAXIMIZE THE CULTIVATION AND PROPAGATION OF EXPORT-ORIENTED AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTS.

rows.remarks: Interpellated by Reps. Cerilles, Fua, Alfelor, Ong and Apostol.  Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: A027
rows.title_full: REPORT ON THEIR MISSION TO THE UNITED STATES RE:  BILL ON FILIPINO VETERANS OF WORLD WAR II
rows.title_short: CONGRESSIONAL LOBBY GROUP TO THE U.S.
rows.abstract: APPRISED HIS COLLEAGUES ON THE EFFORTS FOR THE PASSAGE OF THE EQUITY BILL FOR FILIPINO VETERANS BY THE CONGRESSIONAL LOBBY GROUP TO THE U.S.  RELATED THAT THE GROUP WENT TO THE U.S. TO PERSUADE AS MANY SENATORS TO SUPPORT SB 1315 PROVIDING BENEFITS TO VETERANS THAT WOULD ALLOW FILIPINO VETERANS RESIDING IN THE U.S. TO GET THE SAME BENEFITS AS THEIR AMERICAN COUNTERPARTS.  URGED THE HOUSE LEADERSHIP TO CONTINUE ITS SUPPORT TO THE LOBBY GROUP FOR ANOTHER U.S. MISSION THAT WILL SUPPORT THE CAMPAIGN BY THE PHILIPPINE EMBASSY AND THE FILIPINO-AMERICAN COMMUNITIES FOR THE PASSAGE OF THE BILL IN THE LOWER HOUSE.  EXPRESSED HOPE THAT THE MEASURE WILL FINALLY BE VOTED UPON AND ENJOINED HIS COLLEAGUES TO LOBBY FOR ITS PASSAGE THROUGH THEIR RELATIVES IN U.S.
rows.status: Consigned to the Archives on 2008-06-03
rows.remarks: Interpellated by Reps. Cerilles and Romulo.  Referred to the Committee on Rules.

rows.title_full: OVERLAPPING JURISDICTIONS OF THE MARITIME POLICE, COAST GUARD AND PHILIPPINE NAVY IN ADDRESSING HIGH SEAS PIRACY PROBLEM IN ZAMBOANGA DEL SUR
rows.abstract: TALKED ABOUT THE PIRACY IN ZAMBOANGA DEL SUR AND IN NEIGHBORING PROVINCES.  LAMENTED THAT THERE SEEMS TO BE AN OVERLAPPING OF JURISDICTION AMONG THE MARITIME POLICE, PHILIPPINE COAST GUARD(PCG) AND THE PHILIPPINE NAVY(PN) WITH REGARD TO THE PEACE AND ORDER PROBLEM IN THE AREA.  STATED THAT NOBODY IS PROTECTING THE SMALL FISHERMEN FROM SUCH PIRATES WHO CONTINUOUSLY ASK MONEY FROM THEM.  DISCUSSED THE PROBLEM WITH THE DEPARTMENT OF NATIONAL DEFENSE WHICH COME OUT WITH A PROGRAM TO ENABLE THE FISHERMEN TO PROTECT THEMSELVES.  APPEALED TO THE MEMBERS TO DEFEND THE SMALL FISHERMEN BY COMING OUT WITH AN INVESTIGATION ON THE PIRACY IN THE SEAS OF ZAMBOANGA PENINSULA AND FIND SOLUTIONS THEREIN.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2008-06-03
rows.remarks: Referred to the Committee on Rules.

rows.title_full: REACTION TO A NEWS ARTICLE IN THE MANILA BULLETIN WHICH STATED THAT ORIENTAL MINDORO RANKS AS THE 12TH POOREST PROVINCE IN THE COUNTRY
rows.abstract: DISPUTED THE PUBLISHED REPORT STATING THAT ORIENTAL MINDORO RANKS AS 12TH POOREST PROVINCE IN THE COUNTRY.  RELATED IN HIS SPEECH THE ACCOLADES THE PROVINCE HAS RECEIVED WHEN HE WAS STILL THE OGVERNOR. - 4TH HIGHEST FOOD PRODUCER IN THE COUNTRY;9TH TOURIST DESTINATION OF THE COUNTRY - AND HAD EARNED FOR HIM AS THE MOST OUTSTANDING GOVERNOR IN CALAMITY MANAGEMENT.  UNDERSCORED THAT THE PEOPLE OF MINDORO ARE DETERMINED TO TURN THE TIDE ONCE MORE, THE SAME WAY THAT THEY SUCCESSFULLY DID IN THE PAST AND LIKEWISE EXPRESSED CONFIDENCE THAT WITH EVERYBODY'S HELP MINDORO WILL RISE AGAIN.
rows.status: Consigned to the Archives on 2008-06-03
rows.remarks: Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.title_full: ALLEGED MOCKERY OF THE COMMUNITY MORTGAGE PROGRAM (CMP) BY OFFICIALS OF VARIOUS HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATIONS IN HIS DISTRICT
rows.abstract: CALLED ATTENTION TO THE ALLEGED SCAM BEING PERPETRATED BY THE ANAKBAYAN HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATION IN HIS DISTRICT IN PACO, MANILA, THROUGH THE GOVERNMENT'S COMMUNITY MORTGAGE PROGRAM (CMP).  EXPLAINED THAT SAID PROGRAM WAS CREATED BY VIRTUE OF THE COMPREHENSIVE INTEGRATED SHELTER FINANCE ACT (CISEA)AND STRESSED THAT IT WAS CRAFTED TO ADDRESS THE PROBLEM OF SHELTER AND GIVE DIGNITY TO THE PEOPLE AS INFORMAL SETTLERS.  LAMENTED THAT THE ASSOCIATION AUTHORIZED TO TAKE OUT SIX MILLION TO BUY PRIVATE OR GOVERNMENT LANDS THROUGH THE CMP HAS FAILED TO PERFORM ITS TASKS IN THE LAST 16 YEARS.  STRESSED THAT THE NHMFC SHOULD REVISE ITS POLICIES SO AS TO REQUIRE BENEFICIARIES TO DIRECTLY REMIT PAYMENTS TO BANK ACCOUNTS UNDER THE NAMES OF THEIR ASSOCIATIONS.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT since 2008-06-10
rows.remarks: Interpellated by Reps. Cerilles, Valencia, Duavit, Zialcita, Crisologo, Gatlabayan and Barzaga.  Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: E022
rows.abstract: SPOKE ON FILIPINO YOUTH BEING DEPRIVED OF THEIR RIGHT TO EDUCATION.  ALARMED BY REPORTS THAT INSPITE OF THE SOARING PRICES OF BASIC NEEDS, MANY HIGHER EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (HEIs) ARE ABOUT TO INCREASE THEIR TUITION AND OTHER SCHOOL FEES.  NOTED THAT THE PRESIDENT'S ORDER AND APPEAL TO FREEZE TUITION RATES IS QUESTIONABLE BECAUSE THE PERIOD OF CONSULTATION AND APPROVAL OF INCREASE HAS LONG BEEN FINISHED.  DISCLOSED THAT THE PRESIDENT HERSELF WAS INSTRUMENTAL IN ALLOWING SCHOOLS TO HIKE THEIR TUITION AND OTHER FEES WITHOUT LIMIT AND WITHOUT FEAR OF ANY SANCTION.  RECOMMENDED SEVERAL PROPOSALS TO IMMEDIATELY ADDRESS THE PROSPECTS OF HIGHER TUITION FEES AND OTHER FEES.

rows.remarks: Interpellated by Reps. Cerilles and Alfelor.  Referred to the Committee on Higher and Technical Education.

rows.author: D041
rows.abstract: TALKED ABOUT THE REFERENDUM BILL WHICH HAS BEEN ALREADY PREJUDGED AS UNCONSTITUTIONAL.  OPINED THAT IT IMPUGNS THE INTEGRITY OF THE COMMITTEE ON SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS AND THAT OF REP. JOSON WHO HAD WORKED CAREFULLY ON SAID BILL.  FURTHER OPINED THAT A MERE BILL CANNOT BE UNCONSTITUTIONAL UNTIL IT IS A LAW; OR A LAW UNTIL IT IS IMPLEMENTED; NOR ITS IMPLEMENTATION UNTIL HARM IS SHOWN IN A COURT OF LAW AND THAT THE BILL SHOULD BE RESOLVED BY DISCUSSIONS ON THE FLOOR RATHER THAN PREJUDGING THE SAME.  MAINTAINED THAT THE BILL IS A SAFETY VALVE IN TIMES OF SEVERE CRISES, URGED THE MEMBERS TO LET SAID BILL TO HAVE ITS DAY AND STAND READY IN THE STATUTE BOOKS TO DRAW THE MOB AWAY FROM THE STREETS TO THE POLLING BOOTHS IF THEY CANNOT ABIDE BY THE GOVERNMENT.
rows.status: Pending First Reading (Filed last 2008-06-04)

rows.author: D053
rows.title_full: WORSENING CRISIS IN THE PHILIPPINE SUGAR INDUSTRY
rows.abstract: DISCUSSED THE WORSENING CRISIS IN THE SUGAR INDUSTRY BROUGHT ABOUT BY THE PRESENT PROHIBITIVE COST OF FERTILIZERS.  WANTED TO MAKE SURE THAT THE FERTILIZERS ARE MADE AVAILABLE TO THE SMALL FARMERS AT REASONABLE COSTS, TO ASSURE THE RELIABLE SUPPLY AND STABLE PRICES OF SUGAR.  INFORMED THE BODY THAT HE, TOGETHER WITH ALL THE MMBERS OF THE NEGROS ISLAND, HAS PROPOSED FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE TO INITIATE A GOVERNMENT-TO-GOVERNMENT IMPORTATION OF THE FERTILIZER UREA, THE FUNDING OF WHICH WILL BE PROVIDED BY THE PHILSUCOR AND MAY BE AUGMENTED BY THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT.

rows.remarks: Referred to the Committee on Rules.

rows.author: E003
rows.title_full: PROPRIETY OF THE ADVERTISEMENT OF MERALCO ON THE SO-CALLED SYSTEM LOSS AND ITS USE OF JUDY ANN SANTOS AS TALENT
rows.abstract: INTRIGUED BY THE MANNER ACTRESS JUDY ANN SANTOS EXPLAINED MERALCO'S SYSTEMS LOSS IN A TV AD.  POINTED OUT THAT HIS SPEECH IS NOT AN AFFRONT TO THE COUNTRY'S GOOD ACTORS AND ACTRESSES BUT THAT MERALCO MIGHT BE USING THEM  FOR THEIR OWN ENDS.  EXPLAINED THAT THE SYSTEMS LOSS BEING CHARGED INCLUDES LOSSES DUE TO OR BY REASON OF THEFT AND PILFERAGE OF ELECTRICITY.  STRESSED THAT MERALCO HAS EMBARKED ON A SUSTAINED, GLARINGLY MISLEADING, UNTRUTHFUL ADVERTISEMENT CALCULATED TO CONDITION THE MINDS OF THE HELPLESS CONSUMERS THAT SUCH CHARGES ARE PERFECTLY IN ORDER.  CONCLUDED THEREFOR THAT MS. SANTOS' STATEMENTS ARE INCONSISTENT WITH RA NO. 1724 OR THE CONSUMERS ACT OF THE PHILS.
rows.remarks: The Body adopted the findings and recommendations of the Committee, as contained in the Committee Report No. 1571.

rows.author: E022
rows.abstract: DENOUNCED HONTIVEROS-BARAQUEL'S MEDIA STATEMENTS THAT LEFTIST SOLONS HAD COLLUDED WITH LANDLORDS IN CONGRESS TO CRIPPLE AND KILL AGRARIAN REFORM IN THE COUNTRY.  EXPLAINED THAT THE COMPREHENSIVE AGRARIAN REFORM LAW ENACTED DURING THE EIGHT CONGRESS WAS ALREADY A CORPSE, AS ITS AUTHORS THEMSELVES CALLED IT, THAT WAS KILLED BY ITS LIMITED COVERAGE, ALTERNATIVE MODES OF COMPLIANCE, HIGH INTEREST PAYMENT SCHEME, COMPLICATED VALUATION AND COMPENSATION SCHEME, AND VOLUNTARY OFFER TO SELL AND LAND TRANSFER SCHEMES.  POINTED OUT THAT THE PARTY-LIST BLOC MEMBERS WERE PRESENT IN ALL COMMITTEE HEARINGS ON CARP EXTENSION BILL BUT OPPOSED THE SAME BECAUSE THE BILL COULD NOT CORRECT THE GLARING DEFECTS OF THE PROGRAM.

rows.abstract: REACTED TO A FULL-PAGE NEWSPAPER ADVERTISEMENT PAID BY THE FIRST PHILIPPINE HOLDINGS, INC. rows.title_full: NEED TO PASS A GENUINE AGARARIAN REFORM LAW

rows.title_short: Problems Of Housing Project Dwellers In Vitas And Balut, Tondo
rows.abstract: INFORMED THE BODY THAT THE UNITED NATIONS HAD DESIGNATED FIRST MONDAY OF OCTOBER AS THE WORLD HABITAT DAY IN ORDER TO FOCUS ON THE CONDITION OF URBAN CITIES IN THE WORLD AND TO INCULCATE IN THE MINDS OF THE PEOPLE THAT THE RIGHT TO DECENT DWELLING IS A FUNDAMENTAL RIGHT OF EVERY HUMAN BEING. rows.title_short: Aftermath Of The Aborted G R P - M I L F - M O A
rows.abstract: TALKED ABOUT THE DISCORDANT AND DISTURBING PRONOUNCEMENT OF THE MORO ISLAMIC LIBERATION FRONT(MILF)THAT THE GOVERNMENT COULD EXPECT A FULL-BLOWN WAR BECAUSE OF THE ABANDONMENT OF THE MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT (MOA)ON ANCESTRAL DOMAIN BY THE GOVERNMENT OF THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES (GRP)BUT AT THE SAME TIME REITERATED THEIR COMMITMENT TO PEACE IN MINDANAO.  EXPRESSED ELATION THAT THE GOVERNMENT HAS FOUND ITS FOCUS WHEN IT ABANDONED MOA, WHICH WAS SUPPOSED TO BE SIGNED LAST AUGUST 5, 2008 IN KUALA LUMPUR, MALAYSIA.  EXPRESSED BELIEF THAT FILIPINO PEOPLE SHOULD BE GRATEFUL TO THE SUPREME COURT FOR ISSUING THE TEMPORARY RESTRAINING ORDER (TRO) ON THE MOA AND TO THE OFFICIALS OF NORTH COTABATO FOR FILING THE PETITION QUESTIONING THE CONSTITUTIONALITY AND VALIDITY THEREOF.  REMINDED THE GOVERNMENT TO BE MORE CIRCUMSPECT IN THE CHOICE OF NEGOTIATORS AND POINTED OUT THAT IN ANY NEGOTIATION INVOLVING THE INTEREST OF THE COUNTRY, THEY SHOULD ALWAYS BE REMINDED OF NATIONAL SOVEREIGNTY, TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY, THE CONSTITUTION AND THE RULE OF LAW.  STRESSED THAT CONGRESS CANNOT AND MUST NOT REMAIN PASSIVE BUT SHOULD DEFINE AND MAKE KNOWN ITS POSITION ON THE ISSUES, SUPPORT THE DECISION OF THE PRESIDENT IN SETTING ASIDE AND DISCARDING THE MOA AND TO ALSO SUPPORT HER DISARMAMENT, DEMOBILIZATION AND REHABILITATION POLICY AS THE CORE PRINCIPLES TO BE OBSERVED IN THE FUTURE PEACE NEGOTIATIONS WITH THE MILF OR ANY OTHER REBEL GROUP.

ALFREDO ATIENZA AMOUNTING TO P2.5 MILLION FOR THE USE OF THE VESSELS OF THE LATTER WAS IMPLEMENTED AND ADDED THAT EVEN FORMER  PRES. FIDEL V. RAMOS HAD EXTENDED P250 MILLION AS CALAMITY FUND TO REBUILD MINDORO.  LAMENTED THAT IT IS INCREDIBLE THAT HE WOULD BE CHARGED WITH GRAFT AND CORRUPTION CONSIDERING THAT HE WAS AWARDED AT THAT TIME AS THE MOST \"OUTSTANDING GOVERNOR IN CALAMITY MANAGEMENT\". rows.author: A040
rows.abstract: ROSE RE: EMERGING FINANCIAL CRISIS AFFECTING THE U.S. AND POTENTIALLY THE ENTIRE WORLD.  AVERRED THAT MOST ARE QUESTIONING WHAT THE HOUSE IS DOING ABOUT THESE GLOBAL CRISIS AFFECTING THE WALL STREET IN U.S.  UNDERSCORED THAT THE BUSINESS SECTOR IS VERY DISTURBED WITH THE EVENTS ESP. WITH REGARD TO THE POSSIBLE FAILLURE OF THE AMERICAN INTERNATIONAL GROUP, INC. (AIG) SINCE IT IS AFFILIATED WITH A BIG INSURANCE CO. IN THE PHILS.  SAID THAT THERE IS THE QUESTION ON WHAT WOULD BE ITS REPERCUSSIONS IN THE WORLD MARKET.  SAID THAT THERE IS THE NEWS THAT THE US GOV'T HAD ANNOUNCED ITS READINESS TO INFUSE ABOUT $85 BILLION IN ORDER TO BAIL OUT AIG AND THAT REPUBLICAN PRES. GEORGE W. BUSH ETC., MET WITH DEMOCRAT SPEAKER OF THE HOUSE NANCY PELOSI, THE QUESTION IS WHETHER THE TEAM COULD GENERATE A SALVAGE PLAN THAT CAN SAVE THE FINANCIAL SITUATION.  POINTED OUT THAT THERE IS THE ANNOUNCEMENT OF A $700 BILLION BAIL-OUT PACKAGE WHICH WOULD BE USED TO BUY UP BAD MORTGAGE PAPERS WHICH WAS MET POSITIVELY BY WALL STREET AND STOCK EXCHANGES ALL OVER THE WORLD.  NOTED THAT SOME SECTORS ARE ASKING WHY THE TAXPAYERS' MONEY WOULD BE USED TO BAIL OUT CORPORATE GREED INSOFAR AS WALL STREET IS CONCERNED.  SINCE SOME SEVEN COMMERCIAL BANKS HAVE REPORTED EXPOSURE IN LEHMAN BROTHERS, REP.GOLEZ RELATED THE THE SEC. OF FINANCE COULD NOT ANSWER HIM AS TO WHAT FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS HAVE EXPOSURES IN DISTRESSED INVESTMENT BANKS IN THE U.S.  EXPRESSED THAT SPEAKER NOGRALES CONVENED A CRISIS MEETING CALLING ON TOP FINANCIAL OFFICIALS TO UNDERTAKE MEASURES THAT WILL RESUSCITATE THE ECONOMY.  STRESSED THAT THE HE ALSO FORMED HIS OWN ECONOMIC TEAM IN THE HOUSE.  EXPRESSED HOPE THAT THE COUNTRY COULD WEATHER ANY POTENTIAL ECONOMIC STORM, AND THAT IT DEPENDS ON HOW CONGRESS WILL REACT TO THE CRISIS, AS NEEDED MEASURES SHOULD BE PRESENTED TO THE PRESIDENT.

rows.author: E035
rows.title_full: SALARY INCREASE FOR PUBLIC SCHOOL TEACHERS
rows.abstract: NARRATED THE STORY OF A PUBLIC ELEM. SCHOOL TEACHER FROM TAGUIG, MRS. LOLITA GONZALES, WHOM HE DESCRIBED AS OVER WORKED AND YET UNDERPAID SO THAT SHE HAD TO HAVE A SIDELINE JUST TO EARN ADDITIONAL INCOME.  STATED THAT MAJORITY OF THE PUBLIC SCHOOL TEACHERS ARE SIMILARLY SITUATED, HAVING TO MAKE DO WITH MEAGER SALARIES THAT ARE FURTHER DEPLETED BY LOAN PAYMENTS TO VARIOUS CREDITORS.  SAID THAT THEIR MISERABLE PLIGHT HAS IMPELLED HIM AND REPS. VILLAR AND CAYETANO TO FILE HOUSE BILL NO. 4380 WHICH SEEKS TO PROVIDE ADDITIONAL SUPPORT AND COMPENSATION FOR TEACHERS IN BASIC EDUCATION.  CITED HOUSE BILL 4734 BY REPS. ILAGAN, MAZA, OCAMPO, CASINO AND MARIANO WHICH AIMS TO INCREASE THE SALARIES OF PUBLIC SCHOOL TEACHERS.  EXPRESSED SUPPORT TO THE PROPOSAL OF THE ALTERNATIVE BUDGET INITIATIVES TO GRANT AN ADDITIONAL OF P17.5 BILLION FOR BASIC EDUCATION TO PAY FOR THE UNPAID BENEFITS OF THE TEACHERS AND TO INCREASE THE BUDGET FOR THEIR TRAINING AND SCHOLARSHIP PROGRAMS.  COMMENTED THAT THE SALARY STANDARDIZATION LAW HAS CAUSE DEMORALIZATION AMONG THE TEACHERS BECAUSE THE BENCHMARK POSIITON WAS PEGGED AT SALARY GRADE 10 OR P12,026.  LAMENTED THAT BY DOING ODD PART-TIME JOBS, THEY HAVE SACRIFICED THE QUALITY OF EDUCATION AND THEIR OWN DIGNITY.  SAID THAT ANOTHER PROPOSED AMENDMENT TO THE MAGNA CARTA INTENDS TO ABOLISH THE MANDATORY ELECTION DUTIES OF PUBLIC SCHOOL TEACHERS.  STATED THAT THEY SALUTE AND HONOR THE PUBLIC SCHOOL TEAHCERS AND THAT THEY WOULD FIGHT FOR THEIR RIGHTS AND DIGNITY.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2008-11-11
rows.remarks: Interpellation by Reps. Padilla, Cayetano, Cerilles, Hontiveros-Baraquel and Susano.  Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.title_full: UNDOCUMENTED OVERSEAS FILIPINO WORKERS
rows.abstract: STATED THAT THE SECOND GLOBAL FORUM ON MIGRATION AND DEVELOPMENT (GFMD) WILL BE HELD WITH THE THEME \"PROTECTING AND EMPOWERING MIGRANTS FOR DEVELOPMENT\".  EXPRESSED DOUBT ON THE MOTIVE OF THE GFMD ESP. THAT THE PHILIPPINES WAS CHOSEN TO BE ITS HOST BECAUSE OF THE ALLEGED COUNTRY'S SUCCESS IN DEVELOPING THE EXPORT OF LABOR AS AN INDUSTRY.  POINTED OUT THAT THE COUNTRY IS FAR FROM BEING A MODEL, BECAUSE THE CURRENT UNEMPLOYMENT RATE IS 7.4 PERCENT.  URGED THE MEMBERS TO WORK TOWARDS THE FORMULATION OF A COMPREHENSIVE PROGRAM OF ACTION FOR THE UNDOCUMENTED OVERSEAS WORKERS.  CHALLENGED CONGRESS AND THE GOVERNMENT AS A WHOLE, TO WORK FOR THE CREATION OF SECURE JOBS IN LOCAL INDUSTRIES TO PREVENT MASSIVE MIGRATION OF FILIPINOS TO OTHER COUNTRIES.  URGED THE MEMBERS TO SUPPORT THE GENUINE ASSEMBLY OF MIGRANTS, STOP FORCED MIGRATION, ENSURE JOBS AT HOME AND END POVERTY, AND UPHOLD AND PROTECT THE RIGHTS OF MIGRANTS AND REFUGEES.

XVII, SEC.1 OF THE CONSTITUTION, WHICH PROVIDES FOR THE AMENDMENT OR REVISION OF THE LATTER THROUGH A THREE-FOURTHS VOTE WITH ALL MEMBERS OF CONGRESS VOTING JOINTLY, WAS BEING VIOLATED BY SEC. 140, RULE XX OF THE HOUSE RULES WHICH PROVIDES FOR THE SAME BUT VOTING SEPARATELY AS WELL AS BY HOUSE RESOLUTIONS FILED IN ACCORDANCE WITH SAID RULE. rows.abstract: TOOK THE FLOOR TO DENOUNCE THE RESURGENCE OF POLITICAL KILLINGS AND TRUMPED-UP CHARGES AGAINST HIS PARTY-LIST GROUP, BAYAN MUNA, AND OTHER MILITANT CRITICS OF THE ADMINISTRATION INCLUDING HIMSELF WHO REMAINS TO BE THE SUBJECT OF SPURIOUS MURDER CHARGES RELATED TO ALLEGED MASS GRAVES IN LEYTE.  COMMENTED THAT THE SURGE IN POLITICAL KILLINGS ESPECIALLY IN SOUTHERN MINDANAO IS MATCHED BY LEGAL OFFENSIVES IN SOUTHERN TAGALOG, UNDER THE DIRECTION OF THE INTER-AGENCY LEGAL ACTION GROUP (IALAG) HEADED BY NATIONAL SECURITY ADVISER NORBERTO GONZALES.  INFORMED THE BODY OF CERTAIN CASES WHEREIN SUPREME COURT, IN ITS DECISION DISMISSING CERTAIN CASES, ADMONISHED THE PROSECUTORS NOT TO ALLOW AND TO AVOID GIVING THE IMPRESSION THAT THEIR NOBLE OFFICE IS BEING USED FOR POLITICAL ENDS. PHILIP ALSTON, THE UN SPECIAL RAPPORTEUR ON EXTRAJUDICIAL, SUMMARY OR ARBITRARY EXECUTIONS.  CALLED ON THE GOVERNMENT TO ABANDON ITS COUNTER-INSURGENCY PROGRAM OPLAN BANTAY LAYA AND TO ABOLISH THE IALAG.  STRESSED THAT THE GUIDELINES ISSUED BY THE SUPREME COURT FOR THE WRITS OF AMPARO AND HABEAS DATA SHOULD BE COMPLEMENTED BY LEGISLATIONS THAT PENALIZE THE COMMISSION OF GRAVE HUMAN RIGHTS ABUSES SUCH AS ENFORCED DISAPPEARANCES, TORTURE AND EXTRAJUDICIAL KILLINGS.

BARAQUEL URGED THE MEMBERS TO INVESTIGATE THE MATTER IN ORDER TO HELP THE PEOPLE OF DAVAO CITY AND SUPPORT THE EFFORT TO BAN AERIAL SPRAYING BY ESTABLISHING POLICIES ON FARMING THAT WOULD DISCOURAGE THE USE OF PESTICIDES.

rows.author: F037
rows.title_full: DEVELOPMENTS IN THE MOVE FOR CHARTER CHANGE
rows.abstract: REGARDED AS DISTURBING REPORTS \"UNSEEN FORCES WHO WILL NOT ACCEPT AN ADVERSE DECISION FROM THE SUPREME COURT REGARDING THE PROCEDURE THAT HE HAS ADVOCATED ON JOINT VOTING OF CONGRESS.\"  ALLEGED THAT THESE DESTABILIZERS HAVE DETAILED PLANS AND ONLY AWAITING AN \"ADVERSE\" DECISION FROM THE SUPREME COURT TO PROCEED WITH THEIR POLITICAL AGENDA AND POSSIBLE TAKEOVER OF THE GOVERNMENT.  EXPRESSED HOPE THAT THE SUPREME COURT WILL FINALLY RESOLVE THE ISSUE PERTAINING TO CHARTER CHANGE AND EXPRESSED THE BELIEF THAT THE COURT CAN DO ITS DUTY BECAUSE OF ITS INTEGRITY, INDEPENDENCE AND JUDICIAL POWER.  CLAIMED THAT THE ADVOCATES AGAINST ANY PROPOSAL TO AMEND OR REVISE THE CONSTITUTION ON THE GROUNDS THAT THIS IS DANGEROUS, TYRANNICAL AND PROMOTING DIVISIVENESS HAVE BEEN USED TO MANIPULATE PUBLIC OPINION AGAINST CHARTER CHANGE.  AVERRED THAT THE MOVES REJECTING ANY AMENDMENTS TO THE CONSTITUTION ARE MORE DANGEROUS AND TYRANNICAL COMPARED TO THE RESOLUTION PROPOSING AMENDMENTS TO THE CONSTITUTION.  POINTED OUT THAT HR 888 RESTRAINS THIS POWER OF THE PEOPLE EVEN BEFORE ANY PROPOSED AMENDMENTS OR REVISION TO THE CONSTITUTION ARE HEARD AND CONSIDERED.  FURTHER STATED THAT THIS RESOLUTION IS A DESECRATION OF THE REPUBLICAN AND DEMOCRATIC SYSTEM OF THE COUNTRY.  DISCUSSED THE MERITS OF AMENDING THE CONSTITUTION AND SAID THAT THE MAJORITY OF THE MEMBERS ARE IN FAVOR OF CONSTITUTIONAL CHANGE.  ADDED THAT IF THIS WILL NOT CONVINCE THE ANTI-CHA-CHA ADVOCATES, THEN HE WOULD BE IN FAVOR OF SUBMITTING THE MATTER TO THE JUDGMENT OF THE PEOPLE THROUGH A PLEBISCITE - THE ULTIMATE TEST.  EXPRESSED HIS ABHORRENCE TO HR 888 AND ON ALL ATTEMPTS AGAINST THE ADVOCATES OF THE CHARTER CHANGE.

rows.remarks: Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: E047
rows.title_full: NEED FOR GENUINE LAND REFORM/COMMEMORATION OF THE \"MENDIOLA MASSACRE\"
rows.abstract: TOOK THE FLOOR TO COMMEMORATE THE MENDIOLA MASSACRE WHICH HE DESCRIBED AS A VIOLENT CHAPTER IN THE PEASANTS' STRUGGLE FOR A GENUINE LAND REFORM.  EXPRESSED THE HIGHEST HONORS TO THE SO-CALLED MARTYRS OF THE INCIDENT THAT DREW THE IRE OF VARIOUS SECTORS OF PHILIPPINE SOCIETY AND MEMBERS OF THE INTERNATIONAL COMMUNITY AND DERAILED THE PEACE TALKS BETWEEN THE GOVERNMENT AND THE NATIONAL DEMOCRATIC FRONT(NDF).  UNDERSCORED THAT TO DATE, NO ONE HAS BEEN PUNISHED; NO COMPENSATION HAS BEEN PAID;JUSTICE HAS NOT BEEN SERVED; AND A GENUINE LAND REFORM PROGRAM REMAINS A DREAM FOR THE FARMERS 22 YEARS AFTER THE MASSACRE.  SAID THAT THE RECENT ADOPTION OF SJR19 HAS SHOWN THAT THE ARROYO ADMINISTRATION IS KEEN ON PROMOTING THE MARKET-ASSISTED LAND REFORM MODEL OF THE WORLD BANK AND ON STRENGTHENING THE EXPORT-ORIENTED CHARACTERISTIC OF THE NATION'S AGRICULTURAL SECTOR.  NOTED THAT GIVEN THE PLANNED EVICTION OF THOUSANDS OF FARMERS, THEY HAVE NO RECOURSE BUT TO DEFEND THEIR RIGHTS AND TO PRESS THEIR DEMAND FOR THE IMPLEMENTATION OF A GENUINE LAND REFORM PROGRAM, SPECIFICALLY THE PASSAGE OF HB3059.  STATED THAT AMONG OTHERS, THE BILL SEEKS TO DISMANTLE THE MONOPOLY OF THE LANDED OLIGARCHS AND FOREIGN CONTROL ON LAND; IMPLEMENT A GENUINE LAND REFORM TO ERADICATE FEUDAL EXPLOITATION OF THE FARMERS; IMPROVE THE LIVING CONDITIONS AND PRODUCTIVITY OF THE FARMERS BY PROMOTION COOPERATIVISM; EMPOWER THE PEASANT WOMEN AND RECOGNIZE THE RIGHT OF THE INDIGENOUS COMMUNITIES TO SELF-DETERMINATION; AND ESTABLISH THE FOUNDATIONS OF NATIONAL INDUSTRIALIZATION.  INFORMED HIS COLLEAGUES THAT THE FARMERS CALL FOR A GENUINE LAND REFORM, THE ABOLITION OF FEUDALISM, AND THE FREE DISTRIBUTION OF AGRICULTURAL LANDS TO THE LANDLESS TILLERS.

rows.remarks: Referred to the appropriate committee.

RELATED HIS EXPERIENCE WITH FOREIGN COMPANIES WHEN HE WAS WITH THE PRESIDENTIAL MANAGEMENT STAFF WHEREIN THEY WOULD BE THREATENED BY FOREIGN COMPANIES IF THEY DO NOT APPROVE THE PROJECTS THEY WANT TO CARRY OUT.  MENTIONED THAT ANY TREATY OR INTERNATIONAL EXECUTIVE AGREEMENT AFFECTING THE SUBJECT MATTER OF THE PROCUREMENT LAW TO WHICH THE GOVERNMENT IS A SIGNATORY, SHOULD BE OBSERVED.
